newsitem.title: JAPAN: Thailand's Amnuay to return to Bangkok on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's Amnuay to return to Bangkok on Thursday.

text.p: Thai Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan said he will leave Japan on Thursday to return to Bangkok, ahead of the Friday closing of an international conference he has been attending here.
Amnuay is in Tokyo to attend a symposium on Asia's future, and was in Fukuoka in southern Japan earlier this week to attend the annual meeting of the Asian Development Bank.

Thai markets have been in turmoil since Wednesday over fears that members of Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh's coalition government may call for Amnuay's resignation given the nation's economic problems, which have triggered a sell-off in the baht and Thai stocks.
Amnuay told Reuters on Wednesday he was confident of his position as finance minister.
On Thursday, Chavalit was quoted by the prime minister's office as saying that there would be no change in the finance minister portfolio.
